decks.notes: Utilize cheap spells and cantrips to quickly fill your graveyard with Arclight Phoenixes, then bring them back for repeated attacks to overwhelm your opponent. Maximize tempo and card advantage through efficient spells like Consider and Opt, while also having disruptive elements like Spell Pierce and Brazen Borrower. Utilize Treasure Cruise to refill your hand and continue applying pressure. The inclusion of artist's talent allows for additional flexibility and options. The deck aims to quickly close out games through aggressive plays and the recurring threat of Arclight Phoenix.

The deck focuses on aggressive creatures and burn spells to quickly deal damage to the opponent and win the game. By utilizing cheap creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Burning-Tree Emissary, along with efficient burn spells like Play with Fire and Atarka's Command, the deck aims to apply constant pressure and finish off the opponent before they can stabilize. Additionally, cards like Reckless Bushwhacker and Monstrous Rage provide additional reach and damage potential to close out games. The mana base is designed to support the aggressive game plan with a mix of lands that come into play untapped.

The main idea behind this deck is to quickly deploy a wide variety of aggressive creatures and disrupt your opponent's game plan with hand disruption and removal spells. By combining efficient creatures like Kaito, Bane of Nightmares and Floodpits Drowner with disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Spell Pierce, you can quickly pressure your opponent while keeping their resources in check. The inclusion of cards like Faerie Miscreant and Mockingbird also allows you to generate card advantage and apply pressure from multiple angles. With a focus on aggression and disruption, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and secure a fast victory.

The main focus of this deck is to aggressively control the board and deal damage quickly using powerful creatures like Bloodtithe Harvester and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse. It also includes a mix of removal spells like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat to eliminate threats from the opponent. The deck aims to apply pressure early on with efficient creatures and disrupt the opponent's strategy with discard spells like Duress and Thoughtseize. The mana base is designed to support a consistent curve and protect against opposing strategies with cards like Blightstep Pathway and Sulfurous Springs.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through mass removal spells, disruptive hand disruption, and card draw using Narset, Parter of Veils and Omen of the Sea. It also utilizes the companion Yorion, Sky Nomad for additional value and card advantage. The deck aims to establish board presence with powerful threats like Thundertrap Trainer and Momentum Breaker while keeping the opponent's resources in check with cards like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize. The mana base is designed to consistently cast spells and activate abilities while also providing utility with lands like Field of Ruin and Geier Reach Sanitarium.

The key concept of this Gruul Aggro deck is to quickly deploy creatures with abilities that deal damage to the opponent's creatures or directly to the opponent themselves, while also utilizing burn spells to clear the way for attacks. The deck focuses on efficient aggression and controlling the board through a combination of creature abilities, burn spells, and combat tricks to overwhelm the opponent and secure victory. It aims to apply constant pressure and maintain a fast-paced tempo to outpace opponents and emerge victorious in Pioneer 1 vs 1 matches.

The deck focuses on controlling the game by generating card advantage, disrupting the opponent's strategy, and eventually overwhelming them with powerful threats. It utilizes a wide range of spells and creatures to maintain board presence and outvalue the opponent. Yorion, Sky Nomad serves as a versatile companion that provides additional value and flexibility. The deck aims to outlast the opponent and take control of the game by leveraging its resources effectively and capitalizing on powerful synergies.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of small, aggressive creatures in the white color. The deck focuses on building up a board presence quickly with cards like Thalia's Lieutenant and Adeline, Resplendent Cathar, while also utilizing cards like Recruitment Officer to replenish its ranks. The inclusion of Mutavault and Shefet Dunes allows for additional damage output, while cards like Portable Hole provide removal options. Overall, the deck aims to maintain pressure on the opponent and steadily chip away at their life total.

The key concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and disruption spells in order to control the game and secure a quick victory. By combining efficient removal spells like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat with hand disruption like Thoughtseize and Duress, along with powerful aggro creatures like Bloodtithe Harvester and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse, the deck aims to apply constant pressure on the opponent while disrupting their game plan. The mana base is optimized for consistency and speed, allowing the deck to deploy threats quickly and efficiently.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on equipping creatures with powerful artifacts like Colossus Hammer and Leyline Axe to quickly deal damage to the opponent. It also includes creatures like Fervent Champion and Kellan, the Fae-Blooded to pressure the opponent early in the game. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with fast, aggressive plays while protecting key creatures with cards like Swiftfoot Boots and Shadowspear. With a mix of equipment and aggressive creatures, this deck aims to win the game quickly before the opponent has a chance to stabilize.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly ramp up your mana with cards like Llanowar Elves, Elvish Mystic, and Gilded Goose to play powerful cards like Bolas's Citadel and Collected Company. Utilize creatures like Priest of Forgotten Gods, Woe Strider, Catacomb Sifter, and Mayhem Devil to control the board and pressure your opponent. The inclusion of cards like Boseiju, Who Endures and Glissa Sunslayer adds versatility and protection against control decks. Overall, this deck aims to overwhelm your opponent with aggressive plays and efficient mana usage.

This deck focuses on using Greasefang, Okiba Boss along with various cards to create a powerful combo that can overwhelm opponents quickly. The deck includes cards like Thoughtseize and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker to control the game state, while also utilizing Bloodtithe Harvester and Fear of Missing Out to generate advantage. Parhelion II and Skysovereign, Consul Flagship provide additional threats, while Blackcleave Cliffs and other lands support the deck's mana base. Vanishing Verse and Fatal Push offer removal options, making it a versatile and aggressive combo deck.

This deck focuses on controlling the game through a combination of disruptive spells, card draw, and creature removal. It aims to outvalue opponents by using cards like Narset, Parter of Veils and Omen of the Sea to generate card advantage, while also disrupting their game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion allows for additional value by blinking permanents like Grim Bauble and Hopeless Nightmare. The deck also has some win conditions in the form of Oildeep Gearhulk and The Meathook Massacre.

The main focus of this deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan by utilizing discard spells like Thoughtseize and Duress, as well as removal spells like Fatal Push. The deck also aims to generate value through cards like Waste Not and Cling to Dust, while controlling the board with powerful planeswalkers such as Liliana of the Veil. Additionally, the deck includes resilient threats like Sheoldred, the Whispering One and Aclazotz, Deepest Betrayal to close out the game. With a mix of disruption, card advantage, and powerful threats, this Mono Black Control deck aims to outvalue and outcontrol the opponent.

This deck focuses on putting pressure on the opponent quickly by playing aggressive creatures like Emberheart Challenger and Soul-Scar Mage. It also includes a number of direct damage spells like Burst Lightning and Reckless Rage to control the board and push through to deal damage. The mana base is designed to allow for consistent access to both red and green mana sources. Overall, the strategy of this deck is to swarm the board with creatures and burn the opponent down before they have a chance to establish their own game plan.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and removal spells. It utilizes cards like Fatal Push, Thoughtseize, and Bloodtithe Harvester to disrupt the opponent's game plan while pressuring them with powerful creatures like Mutavault and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse. The deck also includes cards like Blade of the Oni and Torch the Tower to deal additional damage and close out games quickly. The goal is to establish early board presence and maintain pressure to secure a swift victory.
